title: the one board page at http://127.0.0.1:4173/ shows every registered project's cards in full and lets the captain answer every one of them there: external tasks, crew, log lines and decision cards keep their titles, summaries, badges and details on the main page, no action needs a ?project= address, and a missing title no longer names design/tasks.json
acceptance: Why. The captain said on 2026-10-06, about the engine-wide board hiding external project titles: '這是本機儀表板, 都可以顯示', and then: '?project=the pilot external project 不需要網址這樣區分 審批很麻煩'. Evidence (firstmate, live board on main 8853e6e with firstmate-workflow and the pilot external project registered): `curl http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/state` returns every the pilot external project task with `title: null`, so each external lane card shows the missing-title text 'design/tasks.json 未列出標題'; the same request with `?project=the pilot external project` returns the real titles. External decision cards on the main page carry no `details`, so their options and questions cannot be read or answered there; the captain had to open http://127.0.0.1:4173/?project=the pilot external project to answer D-pilot-T002-1.

Mechanism (root cause). board/server.ts state() (the `if (!only)` block at :1441-1481, edited in place) passes every item of tasks, crew, pending, responses, recent, outcomes and handoffs of a project whose registry state is not the engine's own state dir through `metadata()`: it keeps only the allow-listed scalar keys (:1444-1447), sets `title` to null (:1470), `answerable` to false (:1471), `badges` to [] (:1458), hashes a string `identity` to `external:<sha256>` (:1466-1467), and replaces `summary` with 'External project update' / '外部專案狀態更新' (:1473-1476); `details`, `data`, `actions` payloads and `title_tw` are dropped. /events uses the same state(only) (:2170), so the stream is redacted the same way. The page (board/public/index.html) draws a card from what the state gives it: `title()` at :497-501 shows `t("titleMissing")` for a null title, and the i18n value names design/tasks.json (i18n/ui.en.json:76, i18n/ui.zh-TW.json:76) even for an external project whose tasks live elsewhere. links() at :652-663 adds the design.md link only for the default project's cards or in a selected project's view (:659), so an external card on the main page has no design link.

Change 1 (server). Delete the engine-wide projection: the `if (!only) { ... metadata ... }` block in board/server.ts state() and its comment at :1441-1443 go away, so the main page (no ?project=) returns every project's items exactly as the selected view returns them for that project: the same title and title_tw, summary, badges, crew, actions, details, data, identity and answerable values. Nothing else in state() changes: counts, ordering (the 'oldest request first' pending order), `pr_urls_by_project` and the `mine` filter stay as they are. The board keeps binding to 127.0.0.1 only (server.ts:2099 `hostname: "127.0.0.1"`, unchanged) and keeps its existing sign-in/write rules (writeRefusal, the Origin check): an external card is answerable from the main page under exactly the same rules as a self card. POST /decisions (:2243-) is unchanged: it already resolves an external card's store by the id's owner through decisionDir()/responseFile() (:656-664), with or without ?project=. External records stay stored privately under FM_HOME (design §15.3); only the local board's display changes. Add a `design_docs` map to the state output: project name -> the path the /file route serves for that project's design document, present only when the file exists (the self project: design/design.md; an external project: design.md beside its state dir, the same test `designDoc` uses at :1427-1429). `designDoc`/`designPath` stay for compatibility.

Change 2 (page). board/public/index.html links() (:652-663) shows the design.md link for any card whose project has an entry in `s.design_docs`, linking `/file?path=<that path>&project=<card's project>` (the project parameter on /file is a file address, not a page view; /file already serves `?project=beta&path=design.md`, tested in tests/board-projects.test.sh:110). No text, link, tooltip or message on the board tells the captain to open a `?project=` page to read or act: grep board/public/index.html, board/public/ship.js, board/server.ts, i18n/ui.*.json, bin/ and skills/firstmate/SKILL.md for '?project=' and 'project=' and change any such pointer to the main page (today none exists besides the filter code and the /file links; the worker lists what it found). The ?project=<name> page stays as an optional filter only: STATE_URL/EVENTS_URL (:305-309) and the server's `only` keep working, but with T-222 it changes nothing about what can be read or answered — every control it offers is also on the main page. Each card keeps naming its project with the existing chip (`whose()`, `.pchip`) on a multi-project board.

Change 3 (missing-title text). `titleMissing` (i18n/ui.en.json:76, i18n/ui.zh-TW.json:76) becomes a neutral text that names no file: en 'Title missing from the task file', zh-TW '任務檔案未列出標題'. The page derives zh-CN through `cn()` (board/public/index.html:291) and i18n/tw2cn.tsv, whose entries 任務→任务 (:36), 檔案→文件 (:11), 標→标 (:119) and 題→题 (:120) turn it into '任务文件未列出标题' with no Traditional character left; tests/e2e/lib/board.ts:13 (today 'design/tasks.json 未列出标题') changes to exactly '任务文件未列出标题', and i18n/tw2cn.tsv is not edited. tests/e2e/board-layout.spec.ts:76 and :129 read the values from the dictionaries and need no edit. board/public/ship.js:189 uses the same key and needs no change.

Change 4 (the voyage source comment). games/voyage-2d/src/board-source.js:23-24 says external aggregate identities are opaque hashes; after T-222 external handoff identities arrive unhashed like self ones, and the adapter's existing `/^handoff:[0-9]+:(\{.*\})$/` parse then replays them like any other handoff. Edit only that comment to say so (no code change in games/). If the built bundle board/public/voyage2d is committed, do not rebuild it; if a test hashes board-source.js, update the expected hash.

Tests (fail-first: CI's fail-first runs only bash *.test.sh, so the red-on-base assertions are bash). In tests/board-projects.test.sh, which already starts a two-project board (alpha self-like, beta external) and reads the main page with `sh_` (no query), edit in place: (a) :116 `assert_lacks "$sh1" 'beta one'` becomes `assert_contains` — the main page shows beta's task description; (b) :120-122 the loop asserting the aggregate excludes PRIVATE-EVENT ... PRIVATE-PROGRESS becomes a loop asserting the main page contains each of them (the selected-view loop at :124-126 stays); (c) :178-183 (T-202) become: the main page's beta T-077 title is 'beta pin title' and T-078's title and title_tw are 'beta decided' / 'beta 決定'. Add, red on base: (d) the beta merge card fixture D-beta-T001-1 (tests/board-projects.test.sh:80) gains a `details` object with en and zh-TW `title`, `options` A and B, and one `questions` entry (kind fact); on the main page `.pending[]|select(.id=="D-beta-T001-1")` then has `answerable` true and non-null `.details.en.options` and `.details.en.questions`. No new pending card is added, so the pending-order and count checks at :158, :168, :191, :206 and :212 stay as they are. (e) answering an external card with a question from the main page: `posth` (:104-108) gains an optional third argument, a JSON array sent as `answers` (omitted when absent, so every other call is unchanged); the existing answer at :215 becomes `posth D-beta-T001-1 A '[{"index":0,"ok":true}]'` — it already POSTs with no ?project= and :216-221 already check that the record lands in beta's store and runs on beta — and one new assertion after :216 checks that beta's stored decision records `answers` `[{"index":0,"ok":true}]`. (f) the main page's `design_docs.beta` is 'design.md' (the fixture already writes beta's design.md at :108). Each of (a)-(d) and (f) fails on base 8853e6e. Playwright (runs in CI's end-to-end job, not in fail-first), tests/e2e/board-projects.spec.ts: :53 `not.toContainText('beta one')` becomes `toHaveText('beta one')`; on the main page `/?lang=en` beta's merge card `#card-D-beta-T001-1` shows its options (the fixture already gives it `details`, :31) and a design link whose href is `/file?path=design.md&project=beta` (the test writes beta's design.md beside its state dir first, as the bash fixture does); the held-merge answer at :69-75 moves from `/?lang=en&project=beta` to `/?lang=en` (same clicks, same running/merging checks), and :79 `#pcount toHaveText('')` becomes `toHaveText('1')` with its comment changed to say alpha's card is still pending on the one page. The `?project=beta` page is then visited once read-only, as the optional filter: it shows beta's lane card with its title and no pending card, and nothing is answered there. tests/e2e/board-intent-cards.spec.ts:73 and tests/e2e/board-preflight.spec.ts:70 keep passing unchanged (their assertions hold on an unredacted page); rename their titles only if they mention a projection. grep tests/ and tests/e2e/ for 'External project update', '外部專案狀態更新', 'external:', 'aggregate', 'projection' and 'answerable' and list every hit in the PR with its change or why none is needed.

Design. design/design.md §8 'The captain's board', the title paragraph at :1705-1710 ('external project titles are sent only in that project's selected view, never in the engine-wide view'), §T-125 at :2319-2320 ('opaque external aggregate identities'), and §15.3 at :4912-4916 ('The global board may aggregate authorized metadata without copying private content') are edited in place to say: the board is a local page on 127.0.0.1 for the captain alone; its one main page shows and answers every registered project's records in full; ?project= is an optional filter; external records stay stored privately under FM_HOME and are never written into engine state or public diagrams. No other section changes. In flight: no task's pin, review or gate depends on the projection; a board started before this merge keeps redacting until it is restarted (firstmate restarts it after the merge, as for any board change).

Scope. Changed files (tests/board-projects.test.sh includes the fixture at :80, posth at :104-108 and the answer at :215): board/server.ts, board/public/index.html, i18n/ui.en.json, i18n/ui.zh-TW.json, games/voyage-2d/src/board-source.js (comment only), tests/board-projects.test.sh, tests/e2e/board-projects.spec.ts, tests/e2e/lib/board.ts, design/design.md, design/tasks/T-222.json; board/public/ship.js and other tests only if a grep hit above needs it. Any other file needing a change: stop and name it.
